verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says users can ask Rippling AI about devices, threats, and compliance gaps, and that the AI surfaces answers and builds reports from org data inside the product. This covers the on-demand insights part of the story. Proactive AI suggestions or recommendations are not explicitly documented, and the evidence is vendor marketing only, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented proactive AI suggestions/recommendations, in-depth feature docs on how insights are generated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap—and AI surfaces answers, automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports.
Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data
